study.question: With action tokens absent from the scorer and pooled base, is the observed dependence of summary-action utility on residual bank routing concentrated in target-match deviations or in ordinal action moments? What information overlap or complementarity appears between those families under the unchanged offline information boundary?
study.hypothesis: Observation: g1-r0026-summary_action_task click AUC=0.6599648465675602 versus shared=0.6520786221099297, a routing gap of 0.00788622445763043. The corresponding zero-token gap is only 0.00048144743168598847, giving an exploratory difference-in-differences of 0.007404777025944442. Pooled-only task/shared AUCs=0.6607643852640959/0.6600484431453779 have a much smaller gap. Mechanism hypothesis: task-specific readout especially exploits target-aligned historical action deviations carried by summary indices 0/4, whereas ordinal moments account for less of that routing dependence. This is a directional, unconfirmed explanation of one-seed outcomes; a stronger ordinal effect, complementarity or an optimization explanation can overturn it. The current candidate is an attribution probe, not a promised better model.

study.proposed_difference: One new architectural selector summary_action_group in {match,ordinal,all,none}. After the inherited single batched coefficient/value contraction and normalization, keep item coordinates in all slots and zero only disabled historical-action coordinates. match retains indices (0,4); ordinal retains (1,2,3). Cross with the existing task/shared bank readout in four standalone modules. All and none are endpoint selectors for host bridge diagnostics; none additionally retains the prior zero-token embedding/gradient semantics. No coefficient, mask, learned width, scalar match count, extra scorer call, loss or host setting changes. Prior evidence review: removing tokens lost about 0.02556 click AUC from the incumbent; context-code replacement recovered only about 0.00024 over zero; scorer-only retained less than value-only; combining pooled and summary actions had negative additive AUC interactions (-0.0132947940 task, -0.0066697058 shared). These negative interactions rule out assuming monotone/additive channel gains. All 14 authorized trajectories have success receipts; no failed training is present in this supplied scope. Current joint best remains g0-r0022-support_rotated_attached (0.6667535475), versus DIN 0.6555440824; auxiliary AUCs are lower than DIN, so click improvement is not all-task improvement. Do not report token-removal loss as a causal percentage of the DIN improvement, since DIN itself uses actions and its architecture differs.
predictions: Directional triage prediction: match_summary_task retains more of the all-summary task endpoint click AUC than ordinal_summary_task, and the match-family task-minus-shared routing gap exceeds the ordinal-family gap. Predeclare 0.001 absolute AUC as a practical follow-up threshold for the group-by-routing contrast, not a statistical significance criterion.

If one family alone preserves both utility and the large routing gap, it localizes the actionable uncertainty to that family; if only both together work, a positive family interaction motivates a complementarity test. Negative family interactions would be consistent with redundant information or optimization interference.

All new cells should have exactly the inherited 32129765 total / 31793216 embedding / 336549 dense parameters and identical state shapes, subject to host measurement. Runtime should be near the 365-375 second previous family trials; this is an estimate, not a measured efficiency result.

At fixed model state, changing historical action IDs with masks held fixed affects action coordinates only in enabled summaries, not summary item coordinates, coefficient values, match counts, scorer interactions or pooled base. Perturbing target action or masked history with masks fixed must leave predictions unchanged. Empty histories produce zero summary signals and zero gated residual correction.
falsifiers: Ordinal-only has the larger reproducible utility/routing effect, or the match-minus-ordinal routing interaction is negligible/reversed: the directional target-alignment explanation is weakened or rejected under this recipe.

Both partial families lose utility relative to all, with positive verified family interaction: neither family alone explains the effect; revise to a complementarity question rather than claiming no action utility.

Effects vanish or reverse in host-authorized paired repetitions, or are explained by norm/rank-matched content replacement, effective capacity, gradient scale or optimization: do not claim action semantics or task-conditioned mechanism support.

Any unmasked/target-action dependence, changed original masks/assignments, nonfinite BF16 output/gradient, changed state/initialization, altered auxiliary ownership or failed all/none bridge invalidates attribution until diagnosed. A source-level check is not a tensor check.
alternative_explanations: Single frozen training seed and one-pass optimization; different gradient paths can alter optimization and shared context representations. No uncertainty interval or repeated support is available.

Match family has two action-bearing slots, including a gated rescaled duplicate, while ordinal family has three. Equal learned parameter count is not equal active capacity, rank, activation norm or conditioning.
The fifth match-summary gate/norm still uses position/occupancy. Ordinal-only action content does not remove target information from item coordinates, scalar match counts or other inherited paths.
Original feedback-derived masks/partitions remain. These are conditional action-token channel interventions, not total historical-feedback removal or production-causal effects.

Task-specific bank selection can preserve task-specific parameter gradients while shared averaging couples adapters. This changes effective capacity and optimization despite equal parameters and operations.
The fifth match direction duplicates an existing direction with different support/scale; a gain may reflect redundancy/gating instead of new semantic information.

The prior brand-modulo token replacement was a coarse whole-path control with unequal row frequencies and optimizer exposure. It is not a matched replacement for the present individual summary families. A later histogram/norm/rank-matched replacement is needed for stronger attribution.

The large relative routing gap may be an isolated frozen-seed trajectory or selection noise. Existing trials are not independent seed repetitions. Same-user exposures are correlated; use paired user-cluster intervals only if the host supplies an authorized interface, otherwise state uncertainty is unavailable.

Released delayed actions and auxiliary labels need not be mature online; auxiliary labels match user/category/brand over 24h rather than advertisement conversion. Conclusions concern this fixed offline benchmark only.
